# algolia_composition_rule (Data Source)

Use this data source to read an Algolia composition rule for a specific composition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algolia_composition_rule" "example" {
  composition_id = "featured-products"
  object_id      = "boost-featured-on-mobile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `composition_id` (String) The composition the rule applies to.
- `object_id` (String) Unique identifier of the composition rule.

### Read-Only

- `conditions` (String) JSON-encoded array of conditions that trigger the rule.
- `consequence` (String) JSON-encoded effect of the rule (a `behavior` override).
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the rule's purpose.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier in the form <composition_id>/<object_id>.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags used to categorize the rule.
- `validity` (String) JSON-encoded array of time periods during which the rule is active.
